decision_rationale: This is a large-scale pretraining framework for spatial transcriptomics with transferable representations and downstream evaluation. The provided sections describe masked feature modeling and contrastive alignment, but not a genuinely generative decoder or autoregressive model.
evidence_snippet: "large-scale pre-training is required to obtain generalisable representations"; "Masked Feature Modeling randomly hides approximately half of these patches"; "alignment in a shared InfoNCE-optimised space"
